description.narrative:
GREEN has embarked on programdevelopment (Speak Up for Climate Justice) grounded in current work in amongst others AACJ, F4A, OxfaminEurope and working with partners within and outside Oxfam. This program development is now funded by AACJ(till Oct 2025)and P<(>&<)>P (till June 2025). This PDF intends to consolidate and sustain this donor engagementstrategy by finalizing stewardship tools, deepening donor relationships after the donor engagements at New YorkClimate Week (NYCW) at the UN (Sept 25) and COP30 (Nov 25) and identifying new opportunities and events toengage donors in early 2026. It ensures that relationships built over the past year are notabruptly ended due toa lack of resources as AACJ is ending, but instead nurtured to fruition — enabling the development of concretefunding partnerships and long-term support for Speak Up for Climate Justice!
he proposed extension transforms earlier programmatic insights and conceptual frameworks into concretedonor-facing proposals and collaborations. The initiative acts as the delivery vehicle to convert strategic themesfrom prior PDFs into compelling funding opportunities. It enables tailored outreach based on donor interestsidentified during NYCW and COP30, while creating new opportunities through targeted donor analysis, updatedtools, and dedicated follow-up. By resourcing this next phase, we ensure that promising relationships are activelycultivated — not left dormant — thereby strengthening Oxfam’s ability to secure future funding and build a robustclimate justice donor base

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib was founded in 1956 as the Netherlands Organisation for International Assistance (Novib), and joined forces with Oxfam in 1994. Oxfam Novib is member of the Oxfam International confederation. Working together in the confederation, the Oxfam affiliates can speak with one clear and compelling voice on issues of global concern: climate change, health and education for all, agriculture, trade, and conflicts and emergencies. Oxfam Novib's main office is based in The Netherlands, it supports the work of a network of local offices, the implementation of global projects, fundraising, campaigning and advocacy. Oxfam Novib’s the Hague office contributes towards this project’s implementation.
